# What should you charge for a voice-over project?

> Free voice-over rate calculator for freelance VO artists. Price a commercial, e-learning, IVR, or explainer script per word or per finished minute, scaled by usage/licensing term (internal, web, broadcast, buyout) — or price an audiobook per finished hour from manuscript word count. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
